headline: DeepSeek's 37.6% provider share and a 5-day record streak keep the top of the board crowded
summary: DeepSeek's provider share hit 37.6% today, up 3.1 points on the day, and its flagship deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 is on day 5 of holding its all-time record at 24.7% token share. Meanwhile, the top two providers, DeepSeek and Zhipu AI, together hold 49.6%, and the top three reach 58.3% with OpenAI.
highlights: DeepSeek's 37.6% provider share is the biggest number on the board, and it's gained 3.1 points since yesterday.
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 is on day 5 of its all-time record at 24.7% token share, and it still isn't giving up the top spot.
Zhipu AI (12.0%) and OpenAI (8.7%) round out the top three, which together hold 58.3% of tokens.
Newcomers this round: mistralai/mistral-nemo at 47th, deepseek/deepseek-v3.2-20251201 at 50th, and stepfun/step-3.7-flash-20260528 at 51st.
Three models fell off the chart: qwen/qwen3.7-flash-20260727, openai/gpt-6-astra-20260903, and openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions-20261006.
minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash-20261019 set a fresh all-time high of 1.4% token share, now on day 2 of that record.
